title: Jazz ain't jazz until it be Jazz which ain't not not jazz but broken beats and stolen feats amd polyrhythms hidden in fusions ridden into found sounds
summary: Jazz ain't jazz until it be Jazz which ain't not not jazz but broken beats and stolen feats amd polyrhythms hidden in fusions ridden into found sounds floating in a Bitches Brew drank during Foreplay #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Jazz
    ain't jazz
until it be
  Jazz
which ain't
   not not
jazz
  but broken
beats and
  stolen
feats amd
polyrhythms
hidden
in fusions
ridden
into found
sounds
floating in a
Bitches
Brew drank
during Foreplay
#smallpoems
